title: Schemark Configuration
description: Meta-schema for schemark.json files. Each schemark.json describes the directly-owned subdirectories and files, with support for nested definitions that can be overridden by child schemark.json files.

$schema.description: Pointer to this meta-schema, enables IDE assistance.

$defs.description: Local reusable rule definitions. Reference them with { "$ref": "#/$defs/<key>" }.

strict.description: When true, any direct child not matched by directories/files is illegal.

directories.description: Rules for direct child directories of this directory.

files.description: Rules for direct child files of this directory.

typeKey.description: kebab-case identifier; surfaces as the meta-output group name. Must not equal the reserved keywords `frontmatter` or `path`. Must be unique across the resolution path (root → matched directory → matched file).

templateString.description: String containing zero or more `${captureGroupName}` interpolations referring to named capture groups in the rule's own `pattern`. Use `$$` to emit a literal `$`.

jsonSchemaFieldDef.description: Subset of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 used to describe a single field. Tools MAY accept additional standard JSON Schema keywords beyond those listed; unknown keywords are passed through to the underlying validator.

metaFieldObject.description: Object form of a meta field: a JSON Schema definition plus a `value` template. After interpolation, the value is type-converted (per `type`/`format`) and validated against the schema.

type.description: Capture-group values are always strings before conversion; only scalar types are meaningful here.

metaFieldValue.description: A meta field value: a JSON primitive (string, number, boolean, null) used as a constant, or an object form with a JSON Schema and `value` template.

frontmatterSchema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 subset) describing the YAML frontmatter object of the matched MD file. `type: "object"` is implied and need not be written. Supports `properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties`, etc.

directoryRule.description: Reserved keys: `pattern`, `required`, `directories`, `files`. Any other key is treated as a meta field name; its value follows `metaFieldValue`.

pattern.description: JS-flavored regex with optional named capture groups; matched against the bare directory name.

required.description: When true, the parent directory MUST contain at least one entry matching this rule's `pattern`.

directories.description: Nested directory rules for this directory's children. Inherited if no schemark.json exists in the matched directory; completely overridden (no field-level merge) if one does.

files.description: Nested file rules for this directory's children. Inherited if no schemark.json exists in the matched directory; completely overridden (no field-level merge) if one does.

$ref.description: Reference to a local $defs entry, e.g. "#/$defs/myRule".

fileRule.description: Reserved keys: `pattern`, `required`, `frontmatter`. Any other key is treated as a meta field name; its value follows `metaFieldValue`.

pattern.description: JS-flavored regex matched against the bare file name (e.g. meeting-20260415-站会纪要.md).

required.description: When true, the parent directory MUST contain at least one file matching this rule's `pattern`.

$ref.description: Reference to a local $defs entry, e.g. "#/$defs/myRule".
